new_page.description: Montecito, Burnaby houses for sale: 18 listed in October 2026, monthly sales and how Montecito compares with Burnaby. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Montecito Houses for Sale | Burnaby Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Montecito. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Montecito, Burnaby: 18 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 8 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Montecito rose from 16 in June to 18 in October (+12.5%), and 10 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.2% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Montecito?
Montecito also had 11 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 18 houses listed. The Montecito condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Montecito home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

12 houses sold in Montecito with a median price of $2,022,500 (the middle half sold between $1,756,250 and $2,340,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 94.8% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $663 per square foot, a median year built of 1967 and a median lot of 8,634 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Montecito?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses listed in Montecito. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Montecito a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Montecito had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Montecito from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Montecito over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Montecito?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Montecito sell for?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in Montecito between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,022,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Montecito?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.8% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
